housing: Fayetteville's rentals are mostly single-family homes and apartment complexes, many rented by military families.

localRules.text: Fayetteville's Rental Action Management Program requires owners of rentals with repeated code violations to register them with the city.

tenantHelp.name: Legal Aid of North Carolina
tenantHelp.what: free legal help with evictions, repairs and housing problems

climate: Test the air conditioning and check for mold and pests; summers are hot and humid.
fact: Fayetteville is next to Fort Bragg, so many leases follow military moves and include military clauses.
